consumer: An engine-computed possession check (a dialogue/mission has_item/has_amount-style predicate) asking 'does the avatar possess a working multitool?'
scope: The full carried/reachable inventory the engine possession predicate searches, including nested container contents and a 'working' (functional/charged) condition, not just top-level stacks
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items iterates only ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() top-level stacks and emits raw item fields; it never calls an engine possession predicate and never recurses into container contents
divergence: A multitool nested inside a backpack pocket: the engine possession check returns true, but the top-level inv_const_slice() enumeration omits the nested item, so the snapshot wrongly reports 'not carried' (also a depleted/broken multitool would be listed as present though not working)
